analysis_plan.clustering: issuer-level table; questions from one filing are never treated as independent observations
analysis_plan.dev_separation: development results are never pooled with holdout results
analysis_plan.primary: paired comparison of combined exact-answer correctness per question, both arms on the same questions
analysis_plan.reporting: one run, all results preserved unfiltered: failures, refusals, false answers, citation failures and unsupported answers. No performance gate may censor the first run.
analysis_plan.timing: cold build per arm, warm per-question latency, and cold cost amortised over the scored questions; timing is environment-specific and reported separately from correctness
analysis_plan.uncertainty: issuer-cluster bootstrap (2000 resamples, seed 20261123) of the paired exact-rate difference, plus an exact sign test on discordant pairs

freeze_rules.no_tuning: no resolver change, question change or alias addition may follow the run and still be called a holdout
freeze_rules.one_run: the first scored run is executed once on this cohort; its artifact is preserved
freeze_rules.post_freeze_change: any change to a frozen input or to resolution code makes this cohort a development set
freeze_rules.verification: scripts/answer_semantics_holdout_evaluate.py calls --check and refuses to run on drift

metrics.abstention_denominator: questions whose gold class is conflicting_evidence or structurally_unanswerable
metrics.answerable_denominator: questions whose gold class is xbrl_verified after exclusions
metrics.citation_accuracy: answered answerable questions whose cited accession, row label and raw text match gold / answered
metrics.citation_failures: numerically right but cited accession, row or raw text wrong
metrics.combined_exact_rate: numerical and citation and source all correct / answerable
metrics.false_confident_answers: answered answerable questions with a wrong amount, period or unit
metrics.justified_abstention: a refusal on an abstention question for a conflict or absent evidence
metrics.numerical_accuracy: answered answerable questions with matching amount, period and unit / answerable
metrics.period_header_confirmation: the citation's column label names the period it is used for
metrics.source_accuracy: answered answerable questions whose cited accession is the gold accession / answered
metrics.unsupported_answers: an answered response on an abstention question

purpose: Preregistration of the first prospective answer-semantics evaluation. Written after the gold commit and before either resolver is run on the cohort.

reissue.reason: document rights label rejected by the importer before any resolver ran; corrected to the existing user_responsibility class
reissue.statement: Reissued before any score existed: the superseded record was aborted during ingestion and neither resolver had run on a holdout question.

mitigations: every question records the printed cell, the printed header and the XBRL fact so a reviewer can re-check it without trusting the author
printed/XBRL disagreement is excluded rather than reconciled
the question-selection rule is committed before any label exists
reviewer_limitations.statement: Gold is single-author reviewed against two independent authorities (printed cells and same-accession XBRL facts). No second human annotator is available; this is not independent human annotation and is reported as such.

selection.selection_rule: Rank every candidate below by sha256(seed + '/' + cik) as a hex string and take the first selection_count candidates that filed a 10-K with a period of report in target_fiscal_year. Candidates are the issuers listed here, which excludes every development issuer in corpus.json. The rule, seed and universe are committed before any resolver is run on the selected filings; changing any of them after seeing resolver output voids the holdout.
